display_name: 真实IQ接收机频谱对比：跨TX与日期可迁移性诊断
description: L-only物理观测，检查RX共同频谱差异能否迁移到排除TX和日期；不优化V、不训练身份模型
authorization: 持续优化目标下的源域机制研究；使用真实IQ验证解耦对象，避免围绕接近饱和的源V选择机制

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque UID;15domain round-robin, within-domain private permutation before reuse; no TX grouping or same-sig cross-RX pairing

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: Only L_s IQ/TX/RX/day/opaque IDs consumed. Legacy source cache also deserializes V and old features, which are not used. U not opened. No target.

permissions.claim_scope: L-only RX-associated physical contrasts; neither identity accuracy nor unseen-RX generalization

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing source cache physical L IDs and source manifest
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: no checkpoint loaded; existing validated source cache provenance checked at runtime

execution.gpu_policy: CPU diagnostic with 2 torch threads, scheduler reserves one slot within <=3 total processes per GPU; no GPU computation
execution.stop_rule: technical failure retains output; no automatic retry/overwrite

metric_names: crossfit squared error relative to zero contrast
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: L measured contrast after held-out TX AND day fit; no identity classifier

config.crossfit: 18 folds: estimate on other five TX AND other two days; test mean RX contrast of excluded TX/day
config.selection: report all fixed observations; no V/target selection or automatic identity training
config.interpretation: RX-associated response may combine receiver, propagation and acquisition effects; not a calibrated receiver transfer function
config.seed_notes: deterministic IQ-only diagnosis of fixed shared L split; no identity model, training seed or random fit

rows.seed_notes: deterministic IQ-only diagnosis of fixed shared L split; no identity model, training seed or random fit; fixed split inherits preparation contract, not regenerated
rows.budget_ref: 0 identity updates, deterministic 6300 L IQ and 18 crossfit cells; one physical dataset shared by three model seeds

notes: This is a physical diagnostic, not a new identity-training arm or a seed budget reduction.
Source V is not accessed or used for candidate ranking.
Effects may mix receiver and propagation/acquisition; no pure hardware identification claim.
Known-TX samples legitimately carry TX labels; no U TX labels or UID pairing.
No target-triggered new mechanism choice; motivated by previous source graph RX clustering and user V-health-only steering.

independent_review.scope: minimal8: L-only math, exclusion, real IQ, no checkpoint/target mutation, single-row launch
independent_review.evidence: stage2_release_review independent read-only review: P0/P1=0; TX AND day exclusion, IQ/DCT math, L-only access, one-row transport and output protection
